patch_ipdb: patch the IPython debugger to use IPython.display.display for rich output
unpatch_ipdb: unpatch the IPython debugger to restore its original displayhook
displayhook_with_ipython: display results with IPython.display.display instead of printing to console
patch_ipdb_force: patch the IPython debugger with force=True to reapply the displayhook override
test_patch_ipdb: test the patch_ipdb and unpatch_ipdb functions to verify debugger displayhook behavior
